retry_rule: Same semantic input, request ID and idempotency key; attempt number belongs in the event log.
technical_retry_exhausted: Persist blocked/partial status and assign service owner; no new scientific result.
context_rule: Registry, manifest and canonical attributes must agree before prediction.
approval_binding: SHA-256 of complete DecisionBrief including version bundle; changed content requires new assessment and review.

states.NEEDS_METADATA: Query exact manifest once; if unresolved, stop dependent calls and ask data owner.
states.MODEL_NOT_APPLICABLE: Abstain or select a registered eligible alternative; not a negative biological result.
states.TECHNICAL_RETRY: Retry transient error at most once; preserve same inputs/key.
states.SCHEMA_OR_QC_REVIEW: Review invalid input, context, controls or failed intended perturbation; do not rerun until favourable.
states.BIOLOGY_UNRESOLVED: Valid imprecision, disagreement or cell-loss confound; retain specific reasons for biology.
states.READY_FOR_BIOLOGY_REVIEW: Complete proposal awaiting human review, not authorization to act.
states.HANDOFF_NEEDS_INFORMATION: Specialist requests a specific missing item and next owner; preserve biology assessment.

not_found_rule: No result; retain a source gap. Missing manifest blocks prediction. Do not infer lack of biological effect.
implementation_status: Implemented by reference CLI v1: local adapters, bounded retries, SQLite history, review/resume and simulated handoff. Agents, UI and production deployment remain later work.
